contact.subtitle: We send order news to this number on WhatsApp or SMS.
contact.phoneHelp: MTN, Airtel or Zamtel. We will send a code to your phone.

fulfilment.title: Delivery or pickup?
fulfilment.subtitle: Choose one for each seller.
fulfilment.landmarkLabel: Where are you? (a place people know)
fulfilment.landmarkPlaceholder: e.g. Woodlands Stage 2, near the church
fulfilment.landmarkHelp: Name a place near you. We use it to find the delivery fee.
fulfilment.outsideZone: We don't deliver here yet. You can collect from the seller.
fulfilment.mixedHint: You can get delivery from one seller and collect from another.

guide.deliveryHelp: A rider brings it to you in Lusaka. You'll see the fee before you place the order.
guide.pickupHelp: Collect it from the seller yourself. No delivery fee.
guide.groupHint: Each seller sends their own items, so choose delivery or pickup for each seller.
guide.tip1: Name a place people nearby know — a church, school, filling station or market.
guide.tip2: Add your area and street, and something that marks your gate, like its colour.
guide.tip3: Keep your phone on. The rider may call your checkout number to find you.
guide.landmarkRequired: Add a landmark and area so the rider can find you.
guide.cutoffBefore: Order before 14:00 and items in stock usually go out today, after the seller says yes.
guide.cutoffAfter: It's after 14:00, so items in stock usually go out tomorrow, after the seller says yes.
guide.cutoffMadeToOrder: Items made for you go out when they are ready. Each item shows how many days.

checkout.reservationExpired: Time ran out, so your items went back to your cart. Start checkout again.
checkout.stockUnavailable: One item is sold out. Check your cart.
checkout.overCodCap: You can pay when it arrives only for orders up to {cap}. Online payment is not open yet. Remove some items to go on.
checkout.error: Something went wrong. Check your internet and try again.

payment.title: How you will pay
payment.subtitle: Choose how to pay. You check everything on the next screen before you order.
payment.payerHelp: This phone gets a message asking for your mobile money PIN.
payment.cardExplainer: After you order, you pay on a safe card page run by Lenco, our payment partner. We never see your card number.
payment.codIneligible: You can pay when it arrives only for orders up to {cap}.
payment.required: Type the phone number that will pay
payment.invalidPayer: This number looks wrong. Type a Zambian number like 97X XXX XXX.
payment.codRejected: This order is too big to pay when it arrives. Remove some items.
payment.railRejected: We can't take this mobile money network. Choose another one.
payment.error: We couldn't save how you will pay. Try again.
payment.paymentsDisabled: Online payment is not working right now. Choose Pay when it arrives, or try again later.
payment.momoHelp: A message pops up on your phone. Enter your PIN to pay. We keep the money safe until you get your order.
payment.cardHelp: Pay on Lenco's safe card page. We never see your card number.
payment.codHelp: Pay cash to the rider when your order arrives.
payment.codUnavailableTitle: Pay when it arrives is not available

codGuide.title: How paying when it arrives works
codGuide.step2: Pay {amount} in cash when your order arrives — to the rider, or at the shop if you collect.
codGuide.step3: Riders may not carry change, so have the exact amount ready if you can.
codGuide.capNote: You can pay when it arrives for orders up to {cap}.
codGuide.overCap: Your order is {total}. To pay when it arrives, remove some items, or make smaller orders of {cap} or less.

review.title: Review your order
review.subtitle: Check that everything is right.
review.escrowTitle: How we keep your money safe
review.consentLabel: I agree to the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy
review.consentRequired: Tick the box to agree to the Terms, then place your order.
review.placeOrderUnavailable: We can't place orders right now. Your choices are saved. Try again in a few minutes, or contact us.
review.nextMomo: A message pops up on your phone. Enter your PIN to pay. Your order starts when the payment goes through.
review.nextCard: Next you pay on Lenco's safe card page. Don't close it until it says you have paid.
review.nextCod: Nothing is paid now. Pay the rider in cash when your order arrives.

codGuide.title: How you'll pay
codGuide.step1: Nothing is charged when you place this order.
codGuide.step2: The seller says yes and gets it ready.
codGuide.step3: You pay {amount} in cash when you receive it.
codGuide.placeOrderCod: Place order — pay when it arrives

pending.error: We couldn't check your payment. Check your internet and try again.
pending.pollAria: Waiting for you to pay on your phone
pending.confirmingBody: We are checking your payment. Don't pay again. Your order page will show when it is done.
pending.codTitle: Order placed — pay when it arrives
pending.codBody: Have {amount} in cash ready. Pay the rider when your order arrives.
pending.cancelledBody: You said no on your phone. Go back and try again, or choose another way to pay.
pending.ticketUnavailableBody: This ticket payment cannot be retried for this order. View your order for details.
pending.timeoutBody: The message on your phone closed before you paid. Check you have network, then tap Try again. We send a new message for the same order.
pending.retryError: That didn't work. Check your internet and try again.

cod.step1Body: They check they have it. You can follow every step on your order page.
cod.step2Body: If the seller says yes before 14:00, items in stock usually go out today. Later ones go tomorrow.
cod.step3Body: Pay {amount} in cash to the rider — or at the shop if you're collecting.
cod.helpBody: Contact us with your order number before it is sent out.

ussd.title: Check your phone
ussd.subtitle: A message is on your phone. Enter your PIN to pay {amount}.
ussd.mtnHelp: Look at your phone for the MTN MoMo message. Enter your PIN to pay {amount}.
ussd.airtelHelp: Look at your phone for the Airtel Money message. Enter your PIN to pay {amount}.
ussd.genericHelp: We sent a mobile money message to your phone. Enter your PIN to pay {amount}.
ussd.doNotClose: Keep this page open while you pay on your phone.
